Preserve original ambiguous anatomy and props exactly; add nothing. Include every hand, tail, paw, shoe, pole tip and trumpet flare. Keep the original relative positions of the figures and original artwork facing. Retain every complete visible source tip, finger and toe with a small transparent margin. This is a faithful extraction of historical art, not a stylistic recreation.
